anomaly_and_hypercharge.representation: one generation all left-handed Weyl Q,u^c,d^c,L,e^c,N^c, one Higgs H

causal_set_dimension.assumption: Minkowski Lorentzian causal cones imported to generate points; does NOT derive causal order or dimension from microscopic dynamics.
causal_set_dimension.theory: Myrheim-Meyer dimension estimator in a flat Alexandrov interval.

epistemic_boundary: Established physics constraints and reproducible finite benchmarks; none derives TOE, observed values of constants, E8 gauge dynamics or the Standard Model spectrum.

gauge_running_nonunification.boundary: One-loop extrapolation only; no derived unification group, extra states, thresholds or direct new-particle prediction.
gauge_running_nonunification.model: SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) one-loop RG with minimal 3-generation 1-Higgs Standard Model field content
gauge_running_nonunification.necessary_next_physics: Nonminimal spectrum/thresholds and two-loop RG must be specified, with proton decay and neutrino constraints checked.

minimal_chiral_u1.physical_boundary: 4D local U1 anomaly cancellation is necessary, not a lattice measure, mass mechanism or global anomaly check.

one_photon_locality.boundary: Does not exclude abstract time-bin high-dimensional qubit encodings; does exclude interpreting them as independent localized multiparticle Fock excitations under these assumptions.
one_photon_locality.escape_routes: Additional excitations, matter/environment ancilla, nonlinear particle conversion, or a mathematical encoding not interpreting logical counts as direct local photon clicks.
one_photon_locality.no_go: Passive one-excitation unitary evolution cannot generate joint local number-resolving detections in disjoint A and B.

universal_speed_guard.boundary: A counterexample to an inference, not a demonstration that the real universe violates Lorentz symmetry.
universal_speed_guard.model: two independent stable local scalar lattice Hamiltonians with different spatial stiffness
universal_speed_guard.obstruction: Locality, stable propagation and translation invariance by themselves do not require a shared limiting speed.
universal_speed_guard.required_additional_input: Emergent Lorentz invariance/renormalization-group mechanism or exact unifying symmetry enforcing equal light cones.
